summary: This Dockerfile creates a web server image based on Apache HTTP Server version 2.4, then copies a custom site configuration file into the container so Apache knows how to serve your website.

explanations.3: COPY takes a file from your local machine (httpd/my-site.conf) and puts it into the container at a specific location (/etc/apache2/sites-available/my-site.conf) where Apache will look for site configurations.
